PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. When learning Holding Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Holding Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Holding Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools.

4. When learning Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.

5. When learning Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.

6. When learning Handling Hazardous Substances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Handling Hazardous Substances.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Handling Hazardous Substances.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Handling Hazardous Substances.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Handling Hazardous Substances.

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

8. When learning Safety on Raised Platforms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety on Raised Platforms.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety on Raised Platforms.

9. When learning Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.

10. When learning Visual Programming, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming.

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

12. When learning Driving Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Driving Tools.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Driving Tools.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
